features.evidence: Implemented src/services/retriever.ts with pure hybridSearch(db, query, embedFn, opts?) function. BM25 search via FTS5 + bm25(), vector search via sqlite-vec KNN with vec_rowid JOIN to chunks table for deterministic rowid mapping. RRF fusion with configurable k (default 60). Added migration 004_vec_link.sql to add vec_rowid column to chunks table, enabling proper JOIN between chunks_vec and chunks. Updated IndexingService.indexChunksWithEmbeddings() and rebuildEmbeddings() to store vec_rowid. 20 integration tests all PASS: empty queries return [], bm25 mode returns BM25-only results, vector mode returns vector-only results, hybrid mode includes sources from both, topK limit respected, deterministic ordering on tie, sorted by fusedScore descending, all scores finite, relevant chunk in top-5 for all 3 modes (database engine→rowid 2, process boundaries→rowid 1, static type bugs→rowid 5), hybrid mode produces different result sets than bm25-only, graceful handling when vector extension not loaded. All structured logging at INFO/DEBUG levels. All vitest-compatible tests pass (49/49 across 6 suites). TypeScript compiles with 0 errors. Build succeeds (Vite 34 modules).

features.evidence: Implemented complete hybrid-wired Q&A pipeline: (1) Updated Citation interface in types.ts to include bm25Rank, vectorRank, and sources (Array<'bm25'|'vector'>). (2) Rewrote QaService.ask() to call retriever.hybridSearch() instead of getAllChunks() + keyword overlap — mode is 'hybrid' when vector extension loaded, 'bm25' otherwise, topK=5. (3) Confidence dynamically derived from fused score distribution: topScore*30 + 0.15 for both-sources + 0.1 for gapToSecond>0.005 + 0.05 for both sources in top-2, clamped to [0,1]. (4) QaService constructor simplified to accept (db, embedFn) only — no longer depends on PersistenceService or IndexingService. Removed getAllChunks() dependency. (5) Fixed bm25Search() to sanitize FTS5 queries by stripping \(?"') characters and removing common English stopwords/question words to prevent FTS5 implicit-AND failures. (6) Updated main.ts to pass db + embed to QaService. (7) Updated demo test (sqlite-workflow-demo.test.ts) and persistence test to use new QaService constructor. (8) Integration test (qa-hybrid.test.ts) with 7 assertions all PASS: empty no-chunks case returns 0 citations, cite with hybrid search returns metadata + bm25Rank/vectorRank/sources, confidence varies across queries (architecture=0.59 vs python=0.0), history saved + citations have retrieval debug fields, clear history works. All 56 assertions across 7 test suites pass. TypeScript compiles with 0 errors. Build succeeds. Structured logging at INFO level for all QaService and retriever operations.

features.evidence: Implemented retrieval-debug IPC: (1) Added RETRIEVE_DEBUG channel to shared types.ts. (2) Created debugSearch() in retriever.ts that returns bm25Results (rowid, score, rank), vectorResults (rowid, distance, rank), and fusedResults (full HybridSearchResult[] with chunk details) without answer generation. (3) Refactored hybridSearch to share internalHybridSearch helper, eliminating code duplication. (4) Added retrieveDebug() method to QaService (delegates to debugSearch, logged at DEBUG). (5) Registered IPC handler in ipc-handlers.ts (logged at DEBUG). (6) Exposed via preload qa namespace. (7) Updated renderer type declarations. (8) Created test/retrieval-debug.test.ts with 11 tests all PASS: empty query returns empty arrays, bm25Results/vectorResults have correct shape (rowid, score/distance, rank), both sources in hybrid mode, fusedResults sorted by fusedScore descending, BM25 results ordered by rank, all scores/distances/fusedScores finite, fusedResults have chunk details, no duplicate BM25 rowids. features.evidence: Implemented complete retrieval settings feature: (1) Added RetrievalSettings interface and settings:get/settings:set IPC channels to src/shared/types.ts.
